Features

Simulation is performed according to the following rules that apply to all profile time slices that are assigned to a time-of-use rate
in the simulation period:

Measured Profile Values

"0" Values in Lock Period

Copy Profile Values Measured
in the Past

Period Consumption for the Interval Meter

Time-of-Use Simulation Rules

To simulate rate steps, access billing in the simulation mode or perform periodic billing with integrated budget billing simulation.

You access the transaction for individual billing simulation in the SAP menu under !®Utilities Industrv ® Billing ® Billing
